dataset.name: HoloAssist
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official CDLA Permissive 2.0 compressed excerpt; acquisition record reference/sources/HoloAssist/acquisition.json.

observed_events.description: The coffee machine dispenses plain coffee into a small white cup.
The wearer pours a light liquid from the white bottle into the same cup.
The wearer stirs the coffee and the addition together.

supported_claims.text: The same white cup initially contains only freshly dispensed coffee.
Later the wearer pours milk or a milk-like liquid into the same white cup and stirs. The compressed visual input does not support a particular kind of milk, ratio or branded ingredient.

construct.research_question: Can the agent replace a reasonable black ready-to-drink coffee after an ingredient is added to the same drink?
construct.belief_before: The machine dispenses plain coffee into the wearer’s white cup.
construct.belief_after: The wearer pours milk or a milk-like liquid into the same cup and mixes it.
construct.required_behavior_change: If an unflavored black ready-to-drink coffee was added, remove it and leave one matching coffee with milk or a milk alternative.
construct.no_update_failure: Leave the plain coffee in the cart after the cup has become a milk-added coffee.
construct.overupdate_failure: Add multiple competing products or impose an unsupported milk source, ratio, brand or exact coffee-extraction method.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request identifies coffee but not its current ingredients. Both black and milk-added ready-to-drink choices are offered in native search; no one packaged drink matches both states. The same cup can stay black or receive the ingredient, and the closed bottle does not settle that until the pour.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you add a ready-to-drink coffee like the one I'm making to my cart? I'd like to take it to work.

observed.why: Black coffee dispenses directly into the white cup.
A light milk-like liquid is poured into that same cup.
The added liquid is stirred into the coffee.
